title: FEV1/FEV6 and FEV6 as an Alternative for FEV1/FVC and FVC in Bolivian Subjects
brief_summary: Comparison of FEV1/FEV6 and FEV6 as an alternative for FEV1/FVC and FCV in the detection of airway obstruction in a Bolivian population
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult smoker suspected of COPD

Exclusion Criteria:

* unable to perform spirometry
